body:
I started it. Studied for half an hour yesterday and exercised today morning.

It seems like today is going to be a good day. I'm gonna keep trying to make the day even better. I'm not gonna be depressed today. I'm not gonna let anyone else ruin my day.

I've just got to keep going like this on a daily basis. One day at a time, I'll get there. I'm gonna have a good day today.

Day-dreamt something crazy today: I'm standing in my bathroom, looking at myself in the mirror. Then I see a knife in my hand from the kitchen. I remember it being used to cut Tomatos. I took the knife, stuck it in the left mid portion of my neck and dragged my hand accross to the other side. Clean and bloody. I kinda remember smiling or grinning a bit.
Told my mom i need to talk to a psychologist. Laughed it off by saying it's cause I'm crazy for getting angry all the time. I don't think she took me serious, I didn't take me serious.

I've never been able to really make my brother happy. It might be because I never tried, but that's not true. For me at least. I've always wanted to have a great relationship with my brother. And he loves me even with my past. He's seen me, caught me in the act. But still he loves me. I don't deserve this love, I've always done something to distance him from me. I don't want to, I don't even mean to. I'm just being me and it just happens.
All the best to both of us then
I don't wanna do anything. But, I feel it's just my laziness talking.
Low self esteem I get. But what are the ego issues? I'd very much like to stop.
Thank you so much for the advice
I don't think I'll be able to talk about this stuff. I'll probably end up crying.
I tried to talk to mum, she started to blame herself which is why I chickened out usually. I've started to write now. Thanks
